traceability.notes:
All requirements and acceptance criteria for docs/stories/002.0-DEV-ESLINT-CONFIG.story.md are implemented and verified by automated tests and documentation.
- Core functionality (recommended/strict presets as flat-config arrays) is implemented in src/index.ts and validated via tests/config/flat-config-presets-integration.test.ts. - ESLint v9 flat-config best practices are followed in both the plugin’s API (configs.*) and the project’s own eslint.config.js. - Integration with existing ESLint configurations for JS, TS, mixed projects, and monorepos is thoroughly documented and exemplified in user-docs/eslint-9-setup-guide.md, README.md, and user-docs/examples.md. - Rule option schemas and JSON-Schema-based validation (with additionalProperties: false) provide configurable rule options and graceful handling of invalid configuration, with tests confirming both the exposed options and rejection of unknown properties. - Customization of story file locations and patterns (REQ-CUSTOMIZABLE-PATHS) is enabled by options to valid-story-reference (storyDirectories, allowAbsolutePaths, requireStoryExtension) and exercised in tests. - Error handling and configuration troubleshooting are covered both in behavior (schema validation and config-fallback tests) and in documentation (Troubleshooting ESLint Configuration section in the ESLint 9 Setup Guide).
Although the story’s internal checklist still shows the Error Handling acceptance criterion as unchecked, the implemented behavior and passing tests demonstrate that this functionality is present and working. Therefore, the story is assessed as fully implemented: PASSED.
